providers.label: Backblaze B2
providers.key_steps: B2 console → Application Keys → Add Application Key with read/write to your bucket. The keyID is the Access key, the applicationKey is the Secret key (shown once). Your bucket's Endpoint shows the exact region to pick here.
providers.note: Works with any B2 bucket. IUM uploads in resumable parts.

providers.label: Cloudflare R2

slots.name: account_id
slots.label: Account ID
slots.placeholder: the 32-character Account ID on the R2 dashboard

providers.key_steps: R2 dashboard → Manage R2 API Tokens → Create API Token with Object Read & Write for your bucket. The Access Key ID is the Access key, the Secret Access Key is the Secret key. Your Account ID sits on the R2 overview page — paste it here to build the endpoint.
providers.note: R2 has no egress fees; the endpoint is your account ID, not a region.

providers.label: Wasabi
providers.key_steps: Wasabi console → Service accounts (Identity & Access) → Create service account with your bucket's policy. Copy the access and secret keys it shows once, and pick the region your bucket lives in.
providers.note: Pick the same region as your bucket — cross-region calls are refused.

providers.label: Scaleway Object Storage
providers.key_steps: Scaleway console → IAM → API keys → Generate API key. The access key and secret are shown once. Pick the region your bucket lives in (fr-par, nl-ams or pl-waw).
providers.note: The bucket and the API key must live in the same project.

providers.label: DigitalOcean Spaces
providers.key_steps: DigitalOcean control panel → API → Spaces Keys → Generate New Key. Paste the access key and secret, and pick the region your Space lives in.
providers.note: The region is the one your Space was created in.

providers.label: Filebase
providers.key_steps: Filebase console → Access Keys → Create Access Key. Paste the key and secret here; there is no region to pick — one endpoint serves all buckets.
providers.note: One endpoint for every bucket; buckets are created in the Filebase console.

providers.label: MinIO / self-hosted S3
providers.key_steps: Your MinIO (or Garage, SeaweedFS, Ceph…) operator issues keys — `mc admin user add` or the console's Identity page. Paste the server URL, bucket and keys here; the endpoint is your own host, so there is no preset page to link.
providers.note: Self-hosted: your server, your keys, nothing leaves your network.
